headword: {大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}

definitions.explanation: A consumer co-operative association operated on university campuses in Japan. Run by and for students and faculty, providing discounted textbooks, stationery, food services, travel arrangements, and other student necessities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: Textbooks can be bought at the university co-op.

examples.japanese: {大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The university co-op cafeteria is popular because it's cheap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}したら→入学する：01851_nyuugakusuru⟧{大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧や⟦{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}→文房具：12869_bunbougu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}→割引価格：25782_waribikikakaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If you join the university co-op after enrollment, you can purchase textbooks and stationery at discounted prices.

notes:
Short for {大学生活協同組合|だいがくせいかつきょうどうくみあい} (university consumer co-operative association). Nearly all Japanese universities have a ⟦{生協|せいきょう}→生協：13577_seikyou⟧, and joining is a standard part of the enrollment process for new students.

The co-op provides a wide range of services beyond just a bookstore: cafeterias, travel agencies, insurance, apartment finding, and graduation ceremony services.
